name: TidyQuest
description: Gamify household chores for the whole family. Assign tasks to rooms, earn coins, unlock achievements, track goals and compete on the leaderboard. Supports multiple users with roles (admin, member, child), recurring tasks, on-demand tasks, custom coin payouts, rotating assignments, and notification via Telegram or ntfy.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Path to store the database and uploaded avatars.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the TidyQuest web interface.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: Secret key used to sign user sessions. Generate a secure value with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your timezone (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York). Used for correct task due-date calculations.
